description: Modify snapshot_tests.zig to accept an optional CLI argument for filtering which snapshot(s) to run. If a path argument is provided, only run snapshots matching that path. This enables debugging a single snapshot by passing its path as an argument.
steps: In src/snapshot_tests.zig, import std.process for argument parsing
In main(), after allocator setup, parse command line args using std.process.argsWithAllocator()
Skip the first arg (program name), collect remaining args into an optional filter path
If a filter path is provided, modify the snapshot discovery/iteration logic:
- If filter is an exact path match to a discovered snapshot, run only that one
- If filter is a basename (e.g., 'init_basic.txt' or 'init_basic'), match snapshots ending with that name
- If no match found, print error message listing available snapshots and exit with error
If no filter provided, run all snapshots as before (current behavior preserved)
Free the args iterator in defer block
verification: Run 'zig build test:snapshots' with no args - should run all snapshots as before
Run 'zig build test:snapshots -- tests/snapshots/init_basic.txt' - should run only that snapshot
Run 'zig build test:snapshots -- init_basic' - should match by basename
Run 'zig build test:snapshots -- nonexistent.txt' - should print error with available snapshots

description: Update build.zig to add a build-only snapshots step ('zig build snapshots') that builds (and optionally installs) the snapshot test executable without running it. Keep 'zig build test:snapshots' as build-and-run (current behavior). Also forward CLI args to the snapshot test executable and install it to zig-out/bin/ so the debugger can launch it directly.
steps: In build.zig, locate the snapshot tests block (search for 'Snapshot tests' comment)
Add a new build step: b.step('snapshots', 'Build snapshot test executable')
Ensure the new 'snapshots' step depends on building the snapshot test executable, but does not create or depend on any run step (i.e., it must not execute the snapshot tests)
Keep the existing 'test:snapshots' step as build-and-run (the current behavior), still using b.addRunArtifact(snapshot_test_exe) and depending on that run step
Forward CLI args only to the run step used by 'test:snapshots': after creating run_snapshot_tests, add: if (b.args) |args| { run_snapshot_tests.addArgs(args); }

Install the snapshot test executable to zig-out/bin/snapshot_tests in a way that is tied to the new 'snapshots' step (so it is available for debugging after you run 'zig build snapshots'), without making it part of the default build/install pipeline

Confirm the default 'zig build' behavior remains unchanged (it builds/installs only the main jsonls executable, and does not build/install snapshot_tests unless explicitly requested via 'snapshots' or 'test:snapshots')
Update tasks.json content and add a test:snapshots entry that builds the test snapshot executable
verification: Run 'zig build' - should build/install only zig-out/bin/jsonls (and should not build/install zig-out/bin/snapshot_tests)
Run 'zig build snapshots' - should build (and if configured, install) zig-out/bin/snapshot_tests, but should not run any snapshot tests
After running 'zig build snapshots', run './zig-out/bin/snapshot_tests' directly - should run all snapshots
After running 'zig build snapshots', run './zig-out/bin/snapshot_tests tests/snapshots/init_basic.txt' - should run single snapshot
Run 'zig build test:snapshots' - should build the snapshot test executable and run all snapshots (current behavior)
Run 'zig build test:snapshots -- tests/snapshots/init_basic.txt' - should pass arg through

description: Create tools/generate_zed_debug_config.zig that scans tests/snapshots/ directory and generates .zed/debug.json and .zed/tasks.json with entries for each discovered snapshot file.
steps: Create tools/generate_zed_debug_config.zig
Import std, define main() that takes output directory as command line arg
Implement snapshot discovery: scan 'tests/snapshots' for .txt files, collect paths
Sort snapshot paths alphabetically for consistent output
Generate debug.json content as a JSON array with:
- Static entry: 'exe' for main jsonls binary (preserve existing config)
- Dynamic entries: 'snapshot:{name}' for each discovered snapshot
Each debug entry needs: label, adapter (CodeLLDB), request (launch), program path, args (for single snapshot), cwd, build command, initCommands for LLDB pretty printers
Use std.json for proper JSON serialization with pretty printing
Extract snapshot basename without .txt extension for display labels
verification: Compile the tool: 'zig build-exe tools/generate_zed_config.zig'
Run manually and inspect output files for correct JSON structure
Verify each snapshot in tests/snapshots/ has corresponding debug and task entries
Verify JSON is valid and properly formatted

description: Add debug:zed build step to build.zig that runs the generate_zed_config tool and updates the .zed/ source files.
steps: In build.zig, add a new block for the debug:zed step after the snapshot tests block
Create the step: const debug_zed_step = b.step('debug:zed', 'Generate Zed debug and task configurations')
Create an executable for the generator tool from tools/generate_zed_config.zig
Use b.addRunArtifact() to run the generator
Pass the output directory as an argument using addOutputDirectoryArg()
Use b.addUpdateSourceFiles() to copy generated files back to .zed/ directory
Chain dependencies: debug_zed_step depends on the update source files step
Optionally add watch inputs for tests/snapshots directory so regeneration triggers on changes
verification: Run 'zig build debug:zed' - should complete without errors
Verify .zed/debug.json was updated with snapshot debug entries
Verify .zed/tasks.json was updated with snapshot task entries
Add a new snapshot file to tests/snapshots/, run 'zig build debug:zed', verify new entries appear
Open Zed, verify new debug configurations appear in debug picker
Open Zed, verify new tasks appear in task picker

Step through the test execution and verify debugging works correctly
Test the task runner: run 'snapshot: init_basic' task from Zed's task picker
Verify single snapshot runs and output is visible
verification: Breakpoint hits when debugging single snapshot
Only the selected snapshot runs (not all snapshots)
LLDB pretty printers work for Zig types
